KENJI

01 — ABOUT

About

Born in Brazil, with Japanese roots, and raised in Portugal, he brings a unique fusion of cultural and musical influences. That mix runs through both his ear and his sound, sets built to be emotive and energetic, aimed at one thing: moments people carry with them after the night ends.

He's shared stages with names including Luuk van Dijk, RSquared, Chico Rose and more.
